messages.subject: inla.group.cv() on non-stationary spatio-temporal model
parts:
Dear all,

I have an inla gamma model, with 12 groups and formula:
Rain_mean ~ -1+ Intercept +scale(Elevation):Month +f(non-stationary spde) + f(non-stationary spde grouped by Month and modeled with an AR(1))
stored in "result".

Then I want to do Leave-group-out Crossvalidation according to the paper of Adin et al 2024 (published in Spatial Stats) so I want to run
 inla.group.cv(result, num.level.sets=2, strategy="posterior")
However,  for a day now it does not move on from this line, see attachment.

Do I do anything wrong? How can I speed up things?

Best and thanks in advance,
Corinna
